backlog.spec: In predict's tta(), change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.10 so fewer test images get the 6-view TTA, saving inference time at a small accuracy cost.
backlog.title: Drop TTA fraction to 10%

backlog.spec: Change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.4 to gain accuracy from more TTA; check whether the accuracy gain outweighs the added inference time.
backlog.title: Raise TTA fraction to 40%

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=2048 and scale MUON_LR by 1.1 and HEAD_LR by 1.15. This gives fewer optimizer steps and less per-step overhead, which may cut time.
backlog.title: Batch size 2048 with scaled LRs

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=1024 and lower MUON_LR to 0.18. More steps per epoch may allow fewer epochs (EPOCHS=7.0) at the same accuracy.
backlog.title: Batch size 1024

backlog.spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5, remove the third unrolled quintic iteration and keep two. This saves optimizer time. Optionally raise MUON_LR slightly.
backlog.title: Fewer Newton-Schulz iterations: 2

backlog.spec: Remove the do_norm_scaling branch in Muon.step (the _foreach_norm and the multiplication of the params by scale_factors) and just apply the orthogonalized update. This cuts per-step overhead.
backlog.title: Skip Muon norm scaling

backlog.spec: Set SGD_MOMENTUM=0.75 and HEAD_LR=0.6 to test a faster-reacting head and bias optimizer.
backlog.title: Lower SGD momentum on head

backlog.spec: Change the LR factor to lr_factor2 = max(0.0, 1 - step/total) ** 1.3 for Muon and the SGD groups, giving a faster decay.
backlog.title: Cosine-ish decay tail

backlog.spec: Add a linear LR warmup over the first ~30 steps (multiply lr_factor2 by min(1, (step+1)/30)) to allow a higher peak MUON_LR (0.25).
backlog.title: Warmup of 0.3 epochs

backlog.spec: For the first ~40% of steps, train on images downsampled to 24x24 with F.interpolate (in the forward_step input). Then switch to 32x32. Compile handles both shapes. This saves compute in early epochs.
backlog.title: Progressive resolution

backlog.spec: Set widths block3=320 and reduce EPOCHS to 7.0. Test whether the capacity gain pays for fewer epochs.
backlog.title: Widen block3 to 320, fewer epochs

backlog.spec: Set widths block2=192 (block3 stays 256) to cut the FLOPs of the heaviest block. Raise EPOCHS to 8.0 if needed to offset the accuracy loss.
backlog.title: Narrow block2 to 192

backlog.spec: Test an architecture change in ConvGroup for block1 only: drop conv2 and norm2 in the first block, making it a single conv plus pool. This reduces high-resolution compute.
backlog.title: Remove the first block's second conv

backlog.spec: Set LABEL_SMOOTHING=0.12 to test stronger regularization with the short schedule.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: Set LABEL_SMOOTHING=0.06 to test weaker smoothing.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.06

backlog.spec: Set TRANSLATE=1, which gives less augmentation and a smaller padded tensor. Check whether accuracy holds for a short run.
backlog.title: Translate 1 pixel

backlog.spec: Set the color_jitter enabled flag to False in the train aug dict. This saves a kernel per epoch and tests whether the jitter is useful at all.
backlog.title: Disable color jitter

backlog.spec: After the batch crop, zero out a random 8x8 square per image via a compiled mask function. Test it with EPOCHS=8.5 as the regularization benefit builds.
backlog.title: Cutout augmentation

backlog.spec: In ConvGroup, use nn.GELU instead of nn.SiLU. This tests an activation that may be cheaper or more accurate.
backlog.title: Replace SiLU with GELU

backlog.spec: Replace SiLU in ConvGroup with nn.ReLU (inplace False). It is cheaper and fuses more easily, so test the accuracy trade-off.
backlog.title: Use ReLU activations

backlog.spec: Change forward_step's torch.compile mode to 'max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' to check whether time changes. Alternatively try mode=None if autotune picks poor kernels.
backlog.title: Use mode max-autotune-no-cudagraphs vs default

backlog.spec: Replace the 6-view TTA with a 2-view TTA (the image and its flip) applied to the 35% least confident images, which is cheaper per image than 6 views.
backlog.title: Mirror TTA only on all images

backlog.spec: Set MUON_MOMENTUM=0.75 and reduce MUON_LR to 0.19 to test whether more momentum smooths the large-batch updates.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.75

backlog.spec: Set BIAS_LR=0.08 and WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS=0.15 to test faster norm-bias learning.
backlog.title: Bias LR higher

backlog.spec: Replace the final MaxPool2d(3) with an adaptive average plus max pooling mix: 0.5*(max_pool + avg_pool) over 3x3. It is cheap and might improve accuracy.
backlog.title: Final-block 2x pooling head change

backlog.spec: Set EPOCHS=7.2 and MUON_LR=0.215. Slightly less training time for a small accuracy loss, to test the position on the time-accuracy curve.
backlog.title: Epochs 7.2 with lr bump

backlog.spec: Use train_loader.images[:2000] instead of [:960] in init_whiten for a better whitening covariance estimate. This costs little extra time.
backlog.title: Whiten init on more patches

backlog.spec: For the last ~1 epoch, disable translate and color jitter (use the unpadded normalized images) so that the train distribution matches the test.
backlog.title: Decoupled final-epoch no-augmentation

backlog.spec: Change final_target_mag from 0.0786 to 0.05 and initial_target_mag to 0.55 to test a steeper update magnitude decay.
backlog.title: Lower Muon target magnitude end

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY=5e-06 to test whether the stronger decay helps generalization.
backlog.title: Increase weight decay

backlog.spec: In train(), keep a copy of the model parameters (conv filters, head, norm biases, whiten bias) and, for the final ~0.5 epoch (the last ~2 steps of the 7.65-epoch run, so use the last 3 steps), average parameters with a simple running mean via torch._foreach_add_/mul_. Before returning from train(), copy the averaged values into the model parameters. BatchNorm running stats are left as is. Use torch.no_grad. Keep code under 15 lines.
backlog.title: EMA-free weight averaging of last steps

backlog.spec: In CifarLoader.__iter__, scale the brightness and contrast jitter ranges and use the translate crop only with a probability that decays with progress. Simplest: add attribute self.aug_scale set by train() each epoch as 1 - epoch/num_epochs, multiply brightness/contrast ranges by it. Keep the final-epoch clean behaviour. Pass floats to batch_color_jitter (a Python float change may recompile once; the untimed warm-up covers it only if values vary there, so instead pass the scale as a 0-dim cuda tensor multiplied inside the function).
backlog.title: Fade augmentation strength linearly

backlog.spec: Add a short linear warmup of the Muon and SGD learning rates over the first 8 steps: lr_factor2 = min(1, (step+1)/8) * (1 - step*lr_factor2_base), and likewise for lr_factor1. Early large orthogonal updates on the dirac-initialised convs may be destabilising; warmup could allow slightly higher peak MUON_LR (try 0.22).
backlog.title: Lookahead-style Muon lr warmup

backlog.spec: Change widths block1 to 96 only (the first block runs at the highest resolution, but is cheap relative to block2), and reduce EPOCHS from 7.65 to 7.2 to compensate time. Whiten width stays 24. Expect better accuracy per epoch from a wider early block.
backlog.title: Channels 64/256/256 to 96/256/256 with fewer epochs

backlog.spec: In CifarNet.reset(), change the head weight normalisation from w.mul_(1.0/w.std()) to w.mul_(0.5/w.std()) so initial logits are smaller (the head output is divided by 256 already). Leave HEAD_LR unchanged. Tests whether a smaller initial head helps early training.
backlog.title: Zero-init last BatchNorm bias scale / head init scale

backlog.spec: In _get_tta_logits, drop the crop_tl and crop_br views and use base_views = images_batch only, with flipped views, giving 2 views instead of 6. Then raise UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE to 0.5 so the same number of forward passes is used but more images get mirror TTA. Aims to cut predict time while keeping accuracy.
backlog.title: Skip TTA crops, use flip only for uncertain images

backlog.spec: Predict currently processes test images in chunks of 2000 and TTA in chunks of 2000. Change both B and tta_batch_size to 5000 (test set is 10000 so two chunks) to reduce kernel launch count and per-chunk overhead in predict, which is inside the timed region.
backlog.title: Test-time-only drop of the whiten GELU recompute: bigger eval batch

backlog.spec: Make label smoothing depend on progress: pass a label_smoothing value into forward_step as a 0-dim tensor and compute loss manually: logp = log_softmax(outputs.float()); loss = -((1-ls)*logp.gather(1,labels[:,None]).squeeze(1) + ls*logp.mean(1)).sum(). Set ls = 0.09 * (1 - step/total_train_steps) + 0.02 * step/total_train_steps, i.e. linearly lowering to 0.02. Pass ls as a cuda tensor to avoid recompiles.
backlog.title: Label smoothing decayed to zero

backlog.spec: Set Muon nesterov=False via the constructor argument and raise MUON_MOMENTUM to 0.75. This saves a foreach_add per step and tests whether plain momentum with a bit more of it is as good. Keep other settings the same.
backlog.title: Nesterov-free Muon with higher momentum

backlog.spec: Change TRANSLATE from 2 to 3 for the first 60 percent of epochs and keep it to 2 later? Simpler single-change version: set TRANSLATE = 3 and raise EPOCHS to 8.0 to compensate for the extra regularisation. The padded image tensor and crop function already generalise to any pad via (H_padded - crop_size)//2.
backlog.title: Mixed sample cropping: random 3x3 translation with 1/3 reflect-free pad

backlog.spec: In CifarLoader.__iter__, when self.clean is True (final partial epoch), do not apply the every-other-epoch images.flip(-1); always use the unflipped proc_images['norm'] view (or the 'flip' view consistently). Intended to make the final epoch's data match the unflipped test distribution. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Skip last-epoch flip alternation

backlog.spec: Change the train loop so train_loader.clean is True for the last two epochs (epoch >= ceil(total_train_steps/len(train_loader)) - 2) instead of only the last one, disabling translate and color jitter for both. Leave EPOCHS and all other settings unchanged.
backlog.title: Two-epoch clean tail

backlog.spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5, remove the third unrolled Newton-Schulz iteration (keep two A/B/X updates). This cuts optimizer time per step. Keep the coefficients unchanged. If accuracy drops, the time savings may still pay.
backlog.title: Muon with 2 Newton-Schulz iterations

backlog.spec: Add a short linear LR warmup over the first 0.3 epochs (about 3 steps at batch 1536) multiplying lr_factor2 and the bias/head lr, i.e. lr factor = min(1, (step+1)/warm_steps) * (1 - step/total_steps). Allows the large initial Muon updates to be less noisy.
backlog.title: Warmup of Muon and SGD LR

backlog.spec: For the first ~35% of training steps, train on 24x24 center-cropped or bilinearly downsampled-by-0.75 images (F.interpolate to 24x24, channels_last), then switch to full 32x32. Final epochs are full resolution. This reduces early-step compute; the compiled forward may recompile once per shape (done in untimed first call, since both shapes occur). Compensate by nothing else.
backlog.title: Progressive resolution early epochs

backlog.spec: In ConvGroup, allow a flag so the first block (64 wide) uses only conv1, pool, norm1, activ, with no conv2/norm2. Block2 input channels stay 64. Reduces high-resolution compute. Keep EPOCHS unchanged.
backlog.title: Remove second conv of block1

backlog.spec: Set SGD_MOMENTUM to 0.7 and HEAD_LR to 0.65 to test faster head adaptation with less momentum lag over the short run. Only change these two constants.
backlog.title: Lower SGD momentum and higher head LR

backlog.spec: In Muon.step, force do_norm_scaling to False so the periodic parameter-norm rescale (torch._foreach_norm and multiplication) never runs. Saves per-step ops. Nothing else changed.
backlog.title: Skip Muon norm scaling

backlog.spec: In predict's tta function, set B and tta_batch_size to 5000 (the full uncertain set of 2500 then goes in one batch), reducing kernel launches and loop overhead at inference. Predictions unchanged in value; only timing affected.
backlog.title: Bigger eval pass without TTA batching overhead

backlog.spec: Multiply lr_factor2 (and lr_factor1) in the training loop by min(1, (step+1)/warm) where warm = ceil(0.3*len(train_loader)) steps (about 10 steps). This stabilises the early high-LR Muon steps and may allow slightly higher MUON_LR or fewer epochs. Only the lr multiplier changes.
backlog.title: Warmup of learning rates over first 0.3 epochs

backlog.spec: In ConvGroup, replace nn.SiLU() with nn.GELU() (the whiten stage already uses GELU, which may fuse better in compile). No other changes.
backlog.title: Replace SiLU with GELU

backlog.spec: In Muon.step, remove the do_norm_scaling branch: do not compute _foreach_norm or scale_factors and do not multiply the filter params by scale_factors. Just apply the orthogonalized update with alpha=-lr and weight decay. This removes several small kernels per step.
backlog.title: Skip Muon norm scaling

backlog.spec: In ConvGroup, add a flag so that the first block (channels_out 64) has no conv2/norm2 pair: block1 forward becomes conv1, pool, norm1, activ only. Block 2 then takes 64 input channels as before. This cuts the expensive high-resolution convolution FLOPs; keep EPOCHS the same, or raise to 8.0 if desired.
backlog.title: Remove second conv of block1

backlog.spec: Change LABEL_SMOOTHING to 0.12 and MUON_MOMENTUM to 0.75 together. Both are simple constant changes testing stronger regularisation and longer momentum memory in the short schedule.
backlog.title: Higher label smoothing 0.12 with Muon momentum 0.75

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE to 2048, scale MUON_LR by 1.15 to 0.236, BIAS_LR and HEAD_LR by 1.15, and keep EPOCHS 7.65. Larger batches improve GPU utilisation and reduce optimizer step overhead (fewer Newton-Schulz calls).
backlog.title: Batch size 2048 with scaled LRs

backlog.spec: After batch_crop in CifarLoader.__iter__ (non-clean epochs only), zero a random 8x8 square per image (in normalized space, i.e. value 0) using a compiled function with broadcasted comparisons of arange against random offsets. Offer this as a regulariser, and reduce nothing else.
backlog.title: Cutout augmentation 8x8 on training batches

backlog.spec: Change WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS from 0.2 to 0.5 and see whether training the whitening bias longer helps; no other changes. The lr schedule for that bias remains linear decay to zero over its own steps.
backlog.title: Nonzero whiten-bias training for longer plus lower head LR end

incumbent.description: Disable translate and color jitter during the final (partial) training epoch so the training distribution matches test.

memo: Helped: only slot 0, which turned off translate and color jitter in the final partial epoch (official -0.0538, incumbent mean_adjusted -0.0706, one run). It is a single run, and noise sd is about 0.026, so replicate it before building on it. Slot 14 (28x28 inputs for the first 40% of steps) reached -0.0193 official. That is better than the starting script's 0 but +0.0345 vs the incumbent, so it is a possible partner for slot 0 if the two effects add. Did not help: the other compile, pooling, TTA, width, batch, ReLU, translate and jitter-removal edits, all +0.0281 to +0.2453 vs the incumbent. Slot 12 (last two epochs clean) was +0.0820, so don't extend the clean tail further. Next: replicate slot 0, then try combining it with a shorter low-resolution phase (e.g. 28x28 for fewer steps). Avoid architecture, batch, compile and TTA edits. Look for small late-training schedule tweaks.
